text:
Alex (procurement): FYI vendor just confirmed lead times: 16-18 weeks for H100 A100 backlog, but they can prioritize 10 units for immediate ship from their EU pool if we accept a 9% freight/allocation surcharge. Need quick decision.
Nora (ops): We have 12 pending training slots next month that absolutely need H100s. If we only get 10 now, cluster capacity will be ~85% of planned. Can we delay some noncritical batch jobs? :thinking_face:
James (sre): We can drain and shift some low-priority repack workloads to spot instances. Impact on latency-critical products is minimal if we move 8 GPUs worth for 2 weeks. But need to lock which racks get the replacements to avoid hot-switching KV cache pressure.
Alex (procurement): @Nora @James ok good — vendor also notes RMA split: they will ship the 10 prioritized units now (AWB 789-555-1001) and the remaining 8 in two shipments over 3-4 weeks. They require us to accept split AWBs and sign a waiver for partial DOA coverage during transit. Thoughts?
Katie (vendor): Hi all — apologies for the tight window. To clarify: the prioritized 10 are pulled from EU buffer stock; second batch ships once we clear customs allocations. We can provide consolidated invoice but customs will process each AWB independently. For the partial DOA waiver, it's standard practice for split shipments — we can extend temporary hold credit until consolidated receipt.
Nora (ops): Customs has been holding past shipments when HS code mismatch happened. Please use HS code 8471.80 for accelerators and include CN23 value per unit to avoid manual inspection. Also we need weight and pallet dimensions in advance.
Katie (vendor): Understood. Sending manifest in 30m. Sample manifest (will provide CSV):
```
SKU,Serial,HS,NetWeightKg,AWB
H100-PCIe,HSN12345,847180,14.8,789-555-1001
H100-PCIe,HSN12346,847180,14.8,789-555-1001
...\n```
Alex (procurement): Price note — vendor is adding the 9% surcharge OR we can take longer (no split) at original price but 18-week lead. Tradeoff: 9% surcharge on list $47k/unit = ~$4.2k/unit now, or wait and keep capex plan. Which do we pick?
James (sre): From infra risk perspective, accept the 10 now with surcharge. Our expected revenue impact from delayed models > surcharge for 2 weeks of capacity. Also propose we apply dynamic routing so new GPUs go to racks with pre-warmed KV caches to reduce cold-start spikes.
Nora (ops): Agree to prioritized 10. Action items: (1) Alex to confirm split-AWB waiver and surcharge approval, (2) Katie to send full pallet dims + CN23 values + proforma, (3) James to prepare drain plan and target racks list.
Alex (procurement): I'll sign the partial shipment waiver if legal gives the green light. @Legal — can you please review the temporary DOA waiver template I pasted here? 
RMA Bot: RMA#R-98321 created for vendor DOA coverage, status: pending docs. ETA vendor docs: 6h.
Katie (vendor): Manifest and proforma attached in email. We can also expedite air for the prioritized 10 for an additional $12k total if you need <7 day ETA.
Nora (ops): Not necessary for air unless James flags urgent. James?
James (sre): Not urgent enough to justify $12k. We'll stick to sea/freight and the 9% surcharge. I'll post the rack targets in #eng-infra in 15m and the drain playbook.
Alex (procurement): Cool — locking decision: accept 10 now w/ 9% surcharge, split AWBs ok, vendor to provide HS code + pallet dims + CN23. I'll loop in Legal and Finance for sign-off. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Nora (ops): I'll monitor cluster health and post updated capacity numbers once units are live.
RMA Bot: Update RMA#R-98321 -> vendor_docs_received. Next: schedule depot audit if any DOA claims upon receipt.
